headline: ASEAN summit focuses on tariff risks and bilateral trade ties
summary: Southeast Asian leaders met at the ASEAN summit to discuss trade strategies and tariff mitigation, with leaders promoting new bilateral arrangements to reduce US export dependencies.
why: ASEAN represents a high-growth trading block of 10 Southeast Asian economies dependent on international commerce.

impacts.name: Southeast Asia Trade
impacts.why: Regional summit talks seek to insulate Asian trade routes from global tariff shifts.
